newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly up in higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly up in higher volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed 0.06 percent up in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.93 points, up from 446.64 on Thursday.
Total volume was 862,241 dinars against 743,126 dinars over the previous session.

Banque Nationale Agricole gained 0.52 dinar to 19.05 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie was up 0.32 dinar to 29.52. Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement rose 0.3 dinar to 22.2 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix advanced 0.26 dinar to 31.5 dinars.
Chemical firm ICF fell 2.98 dinars to 53 dinars with only 10 shares changing hands.
Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie was down 0.46 dinar to 40.54.
Airline Tunis Air eased 0.2 dinar to 23 dinars with the exchange of 2,354 shares.
